question:
I've been working on a project and I have installed some dbt_packages, namely codegen & dbt_utils.

When I create and view the dbt docs using dbt docs generate & dbt docs serve, I still see those two packages as projects. Tried the following so far:

  1. This which works fine for models already in my model-paths i.e. they don't show up in the docs site. The dbt_packages folder is not in my model-paths but at the same level as my models directory. When adding the dbt_packages folder in the model-paths line of my dbt_project.yml, I get multiple errors about the version: in multiple .yml files in the dbt_packages directory. The error has to do with the version number not being an integer.

  2. Adding a properties.yml file in the dbt_packages folder with the syntax used in the previous point. Nothing still.

  3. I also tried passing the --exclude argument using the syntax in the dbt documentation, but it didn't work. They all return The selection criterion 'tag:packages' does not match any nodes (in this example for the tags syntax, but the output is the same for the rest of the syntaxes in the documentation link right above.
title: Exclude a folder from dbt docs generate
answer:
You could refer to here: https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/7259 https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/6014

The selector currently only supports the compile phase, and does not support the selection of specific models when building catelog in dbt docs.
